programme.desc: During a rescue attempt, SG-1 is caught by one of hell's denizens, who is determined to use the information they have to overthrow Goa'uld lord Sokar. Using Tok'ra technology, the team is forced to relive painful memories... but how much can they take?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: En route to the infirmary after an extended mission, SG-1 learns that part of Stargate Command has been sealed off because of a chemical leak.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The Tollan Narim invites SG-1 to participate in a ritual known as Triad. Only when SG-1 shows up do they learn that Triad is a ceremony of justice.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: En route to a planet, the SG-1 are implanted with an alien spore that evolves into a being called Urgo. Though Urgo claims to be friendly, the suspicious team members work feverishly to rid themselves of the creature before it destroys their minds.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: After a meteor strike buries the Stargate, O'Neill finds himself stranded on a planet with no hope of rescue.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 travels to Tollana to negotiate a trade. Col. Jack O'Neill becomes extremely annoyed when the Tollans refuse to cooperate, due to their fear that any weaponry given to Earth would more likely be used on itself than to protect against the Goa'uld.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 journeys to a planet where their arrival ignites a war between two cultures. A spy realizes his side could win the war if SG-1 and the Stargate can be neutralized. Will O'Neill and his team make the same realization and save themselves in time?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Bra'tac accompanied by his battered Jaffa apprentice arrives at Stargate Command pleading for medical assistance. He announces that Chulak the home planet to himself and Teal'c has been brutally attacked by Apophis and he goes on to explain that it was as though Apophis was looking for something. Dr. Daniel Jackson deduces that the something had to be Harsesis the child Apophis fathered with Sha're/Amaunet. This forbidden child would contain all the knowledge of the Goa'uld and if he were to fall into the wrong hands could be the Goa'uld's undoing.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: An alien artifact causes Daniel to disappear, and the team looks for help from his institutionalized grandfather.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While preparing for a week of leave, Col. Jack O'Neill is engulfed in a white glow and disappears. Maj. Samantha Carter immediately recognizes that O'Neill has been transported away by the Asgard.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 is called upon to help a race of gentle, highly-intelligent aliens struggling against a swarm of deadly mechanical spiders called \.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Stargate Command is contacted by Alar, a representative of the planet Euronda. His people are under attack and in need of help. Gen. Hammond sends SG-1 on a humanitarian mission to deliver food and medical supplies.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Anise, a new Tok'ra representative to Earth, approaches Stargate Command for help in testing some mysterious armband devices discovered amid the ruins of a distant planet. Anise believes the devices could be a powerful weapon in their war against the Goa'uld.Because symbiotes seem to render the devices ineffective, she requires human test subjects to prove her theory.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: An incoming traveller, identified as a Jaffa priestess with whom Teal'C once had a relationship, claims to know how to destroy the Goa'uld.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A meeting of the Tok'ra High Council goes haywire when an SGC soldier flips out, attacking the council members before taking his own life, putting fear in the SGC as they realize that the Goa'uld now have a mind control weapon.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The SG-1 team meets Malikai, a human explorer from another world who shares Jackson's interest in an alien computer covered in a Latin-like script.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When the stargate won't open, trapping teams offworld, the SG-1 team investigates and learns that the Russians have their own stargate, apparently recovered from the sea after an Asgard ship crashed on Earth.The Russian stargate is locked open, maintaining a perpetual wormhole that defies explanation. At the request of Russian scientist Dr.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While conducting an archeological dig on planet P3X-888, Dr. Daniel Jackson makes a remarkable discovery: a primordial Goa'uld symbiote, an ancient, predatory version of SG-1's parasitical enemies.Before he can bring back his sample however, his team is attacked by an Unas. One team member is killed, and Daniel is dragged off into the wilderness by the giant primitive creature.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: After O'Neill and the team help relocate displaced aliens to a new homeworld, another civilisation tries to colonise the same planet, leaving the team striving to discover a fair solution to the dilemma. Sci-fi drama, starring Richard Dean Anderson and Amanda Tapping.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The members of SG-1 find themselves working in an alien power station with new identities and no memory of their former selves; as the only person who recalls their true identities, it is up to Teal'c to attempt to set things right.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Hammond orders O'Neill and the team to investigate a conspiracy theorist in Montana who claims he is an alien and in possession of a spaceship. While SG-1 is initially sceptical it begins to appear that there is some truth to his story. Sci-fi drama, starring Richard Dean Anderson and Amanda Tapping.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When a recall device is activated on a Goa'uld Death Glider that Teal'c and O'Neill are testing, the two men find themselves trapped on a several-hundred-year journey back to Chulak with only several days worth of oxygen.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When Daniel Jackson returns to Chicago to attend the funeral of his mentor, a celebrated archaeologist, he soon realizes that the death is mysteriously connected to the recent discovery of a 10,000-year-old Egyptian artifact that might be cursed.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The team undertakes a mission to disrupt an alliance between the influential System Lords Apophis and Heru'ur, while Teal'c travels to Chulak to recruit support from the Jaffa warriors in the fight against the Goa'uld. Sci-fi drama, starring Richard Dean Anderson and Christopher Judge.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: General Hammond makes the shock announcement he is stepping down from his post, prompting O'Neill to investigate whether he has a hidden motive. Meanwhile, Hammond's replacement assigns Carter the task of building a planet-destroying bomb.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Ten years into the future, the former members of SG-1 must send a message into the past to prevent the extinction of the human race.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Jackson's teammates notice a disturbing change in him when he is reunited with the Harcesis child and given the Goa'uld genetic memory.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 travels to a planet to investigate a machine that induces narcotic pleasure. But when they try to leave the planet, they are overcome with debilitating withdrawal symptoms, forcing them to stay. Can they free themselves from this addiction?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: During a visit to the Air Force Academy, Maj. Samantha Carter makes the acquaintance of Jennifer Hailey, a promising young cadet with a rebellious streak. Carter sees great potential in her, but Jennifer seems determined to sabotage her future with the Air Force. She is fiercely independent, opinionated and resentful of Carter, to whom she is constantly being compared.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When SG-1 sends a probe through the Stargate, a powerful electronic impulse comes back through and hides inside SGC's computer. But when the entity suddenly jumps inside Carter's mind, SG-1 must choose between saving SGC and saving Carter's life!

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 encounters a tricky situation when they join forces with androids designed to look like them in a battle against an evil Goa'uld System Lord. Can they fight alongside robotic doppelgangers, or will confusion and contradiction blur the line?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 pays a visit to the Tok'ra homeworld. They arrive at Vorash on Cronos' mothership -- one of the spoils they claimed following the their recent battle with him.At a meeting with Vorash's High Council, it is revealed that SG-1 intends to lend the Tok'ra the enormous ship in order to help facilitate the Tok'ra's move to a new planet. Tanith is beside himself.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 finds themselves stranded in a crippled ship in a distant galaxy -- with Apophis threatening to destroy them.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: In order to restore Teal'c's memory, Bra'tac confiscates his friend's symbiote and performs a ritual that will bring him to the brink of death; Teal'c experiences flashbacks of his life serving under the System Lord Apophis.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: After discovering an alien device that has the capability to destroy the Goa'uld, Carter is followed back to Earth and begins to have encounters with an ascended being who warns her that the powerful weapon must be destroyed.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While trying to escape a hostile planet through the Stargate, a fifth member of SG-1 is injured and O'Neill stays behind to help him; SGC refuses to allow the team back through since there is no fifth person on their team.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The SG-1 team is welcomed on K'Tau by the planet's religious leader, who takes the reddening sky concurrent with their arrival as a sign from their gods. What he doesn't know is that the reddish color is signaling the planet's impending doom!

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Cassandra mysteriously falls ill, sending SG-1 back to her home planet -- where they uncover a dark Goa'uld secret.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 attempts to rescue Daniel's Unas friend Chaka, who has been enslaved along with the rest of his people; when Colonel O'Neill and Major Carter are captured and imprisoned, Daniel and Teal'c must find a way to rescue them.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: On a rescue mission to recover Russian soldiers believed missing in action on a previously undisclosed trip, the SG-1 team gets trapped in a Goa'uld tomb with a number of decomposed bodies…and a deadly alien monster with an appetite for human flesh! Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The Tollan offer Earth advanced weapons technology, prompting a secret investigation on Tollana -- one that leads to a startling discovery.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 returns from an off-world mission proudly announcing to General Hammond that through an intermediate race, they have met a highly advanced alien race that's willing to form an alliance with Earth.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A Russian transport vehicle is ambushed and its valuable cargo, a captured Jaffa, is taken by force. At nearly the same time, Major Carter is ambushed while getting into her car and abducted by mysterious men dressed in black.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: To monitor the alien Martin, O'Neill becomes tech advisor to a new TV series whose story line is oddly familiar.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Col. Jack O'Neill and his new SG recruits have become the targets of a secret hostile takeover. Now it's up to a wounded O'Neill and his neophyte troop to save the command center from a possible alien invasion! Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When Teal'c is trapped in the Stargate network, SG-1 is given 48 hours to get him back by an impatient superior officer with his own agenda, all of which forces the team to ask an unlikely source for help completing their dangerous mission.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A truce has been declared among the Goa'uld, so that the warlords can attend a summit on the future of universe domination. Since Jackson speaks fluent Goa'uld, he is sent to the summit disguised as an aide. But his real mission is to poison the delegates! Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Enslaved by the Goa'uld, Dr Jackson attempts to destroy the System Lords, and SG-1 faces an attack on the Tok'ra homeworld.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: As an asteroid hurtles toward Earth, SG-1 uses an abandoned Goa'uld ship as a launch pad for a mega-bomb designed to destroy the rock before impact. But when SGC loses the ship's signal, it's feared that the team is dead and that Earth is in peril.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The Goa'uld K'tano (guest star Rick Worthy), former First Prime of the late Imhotep, is now the leader of a powerful Jaffa rebellion. SG-1 visits K'tano's stronghold with the aim of securing an alliance. But O'Neill and the team soon learn that this strategic partnership may well come at a heavy price. Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A dormant android is discovered on a barren planet and transported back to Earth for study. At the SGC, it is placed in a secure environment and activated. The android, a female robot named Reese, demonstrates a childlike curiosity for her environment world and an instant affection for Daniel. As SG-1 questions her in an attempt to find out what happened to her world, the team discovers this seemingly innocent being may hold a menacing secret.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Col. O'Neill must enlist the aid of a couple of convicted felons in a bid to save a planet from the Goa'uld. With an attack looming and the planet's automated defense systems seemingly offline, an entire world's salvation rests in the hands of SG-1 and two former NID operatives. Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Daniel Jackson returns from an off-world diplomatic mission, stricken with radiation poisoning and accused of sabotage by the host government.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 mounts a rescue mission to save Heimdall, an Asgard scientist, and secure an underground laboratory before they fall into the hands of Anubis.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Jonas is eager to finish what Dr. Jackson started. The Stargate malfunctions, and Carter informs O'Neill that it could destroy all life on Earth.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: With the Stargate transformed into a timebomb, Earth's only hope lies in a gambit by SG-1 that could result in the loss of the portal forever.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Trapped on a Goa'uld mothership at the bottom of the ocean by Anubis, the SG1 team discover the craft is on self-destruct and that they only have 17 minutes to get out.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When O'Neill contracts a virus from a mysterious female found frozen in the ice, it becomes clear that his only hope of survival is to accept a symbiote from the To'kra.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 investigates a sleepy town on the Oregon coast whose inhabitants harbor a dark secret - the zombie-like townspeople turn out to be their worst nightmare.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Michael Shanks returns for a gripping episode which sees Colonel O'Neill tortured to death and repeatedly revived by an evil System Lord.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Jonas' people ask Earth for military aide in an impending war with their rival nations, but his former mentor offers another solution.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When SG-1 is captured by the Goa'uld, their very survival rests with two unlikely heroes. Enterprise's John Billingsley guest stars.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Tensions rise between the Tok'ra and rebel Jaffa at the S.G.C.'s offworld base when they are attacked by an invisible enemy.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: An alien world offers Earth a medicine with the power to cure any illness -- but the hidden price may be too high to pay.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Rogue NSA officers hijack the X-303 spaceship and demand that Adrian Conrad be brought to the ship. Using his Goa'uld knowledge, Conrad activates the X-303 and takes the ship light-years from Earth as O'Neill and Teal'c stage a daring rescue.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When SG-1 is marooned in deep space, Thor comes to the rescue. He then seek O'Neill's help to combat the Replicators. Convinced they will attack earth if not stopped, O'Neill stages a daring mission to stop the Replicators once and for all.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 returns from an archeological site on another planet carrying an ancient artifact that glows and emits strange energy waves.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When Sen. Kinsey is assassinated in broad daylight in front of a dozen civilian witnesses, Col. Jack O'Neill is the prime suspect, having been seen and videotaped leaving the scene with a rifle in hand.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Maybourne offers to reveal the location of an alien weapons stockpile on the condition that he is allowed to go along. However, his duplicitous plan backfires when he is transported to a deserted moon with O'Neill. Sci-fi drama, starring Tom McBeath and Richard Dean Anderson.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 attempts to save a planet's inhabitants from Nirrti's genetic experimentation, but find themselves to be her next victims.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: With Anubis, the most powerful of the Goa'uld system lords, increasing his ability to acquire and use advanced weaponry against Earth, Gen. Hammond decides to break the secrecy of the Stargate program.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 discovers three human survivors on an off-world planet who claim to be under attack by hostile aliens. While Carter helps repair the ship's computer, she learns that the survivors are hiding a secret…and things may not be all they seem.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Teal'c has a near-death experience, which leads to him having a strange dream in which he and the SG-1 team are human firemen living on Earth and he is preparing to donate a kidney; Daniel tries to help Teal'c distinguish dreams from reality.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 accompanies the X-53 on its voyage into deep space. When the ship drops out of hyperspace, SG-1 is stranded with no means of getting back to Earth. Their only option lies in exploring a nearby planet where a Stargate is thought to be located.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 encounters a civilization desperate to be freed from the clutches of a Goa'uld. While on the planet, Jonas falls ill. His illness is diagnosed as a brain tumor but it gives him the ability to see the future...where SG-1 are walking into a trap!

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 is called to defend the people of Abydos from the Goa'uld once again when they learn that Anubis is about to attack.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: As SG-1 begins its search for the Lost City, they discover that Jackson has been returned by the Ancients without any memory of who he was. While SG-1 tries to help him regain his memory, they discover that the Lost City is not on the same planet.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: As Anubis prepares to attack Kelowna and steal the Naquadria, Teal'c asks Ba'al to lead a revolt against the rogue System Lord.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When a teenage boy claiming to be Colonel O'Neill turns up at the SGC, the team begin an investigation into what happened and why. Unfortunately, time is not on young Jack's side.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: After an injury, Teal'c must put aside his self-doubt when SG-1 launches a mission to rescue his son and his mentor from a Jaffa death camp.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The team gates to a climate-controlled environment amidst a toxic wasteland, whose people are all linked to a central computer.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While investigating a crashed ship, SG-1 finds hundreds of inhabited pods. While counting, they are all knocked unconscious. Upon returning to SGC, Daniel insists on getting back to the ship and appears to not know where he is nor who anyone else is.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Daniel reunites with former comrade Chaka in a bid to reach a peaceful compromise as SG-3 prepares to do battle with the Unas over a Naquadah mine. Sci-fi drama, starring Richard Dean Anderson and Michael Shanks.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: An alien proposes to share his planet's technology in exchange for Carter helping him win a space race.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: An SGC scientist creates a computer virus that can be utilized to shut down enemy Stargates, but he accidentally crashes the entire gate network; a System Lord attempts a power play while all of the Stargates are disabled.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 encounters a race of women warriors whose survival depends on symbiotes harvested from Jaffa. Teal'c and SG-1 must convince the warriors' high priestess to put aside her fear of reliance on a life-saving drug before the Goa'uld destroy them.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 encounters a very advanced bio-engineered warrior endowed with super strength, created by Anubis. While the team sets out to locate the origin of this new foe, Daniel travels to South America in search of a device left on Earth by the Ancients.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Having found the location of the warrior base, Carter is assigned a recon mission to determine Anubis's plans. Meanwhile, O'Neill mounts a mission to South America to rescue Daniel who has been kidnapped by Honduran rebels demanding a ransom.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While on a routine journey, the Prometheus is attacked by an alien ship and is forced to enter a mysterious interstellar cloud; Dr. Carter awakens to find herself alone on the Prometheus and begins to suffer from hallucinations.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Jonas Quinn returns with news that Naquadria mines of Kelowna will cause an explosion in the planet's core.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Daniel experiences strange dreams centered around his possible knowledge of the Lost City of the Ancients. Suspicious that Daniel's mind is being manipulated, the team must find a way to help him while keeping the secret from the Goa'uld.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When the Beta Site is attacked by Anubis's drones, Carter and Jacob get their first chance to test a new weapon. Jacob is injured and Carter goes MIA.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 SG-3 and SG-5 gate to the address where they find the nomadic tribe and Daniel Jackson. But Daniel doesn't remember O'Neill Carter or Teal'c and he's not sure he wants to remember who he is because he feels he might have done something wrong. Carter convinces Daniel that he was a very good person and to return to SG-1. The team theorizes that Daniel was expelled from the race of Ascended beings by his benefactor Oma after he interfered in human affairs on Abydos.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When the Air Force sends a documentary crew to capture the historical importance of the Stargate program, the members of the SGC are resistant. Tensions rise when an emergency forces General Hammond to restrict the access they're given to the SGC.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Agent Barrett of the NID calls SG-1 to Los Angeles to consult on a mass murder of a rogue sleeper cell by a woman. There they find many Goa'uld artifacts relating to Sekhmet, a subordinate of Ra. How this operation relates to the Goa'uld eludes SG-1.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The race begins. After Warrick and co-pilot Carter evade the obstacle course's attack drones they move on to Stage Two in which the racers head into the coronasphere of Hebridan's sun. Then an explosion occurs: The ship's power diverter has been sabotaged and overloaded. The Seberus is heading into the sun. Their only hope is to relocate the Naquadah generator bypass the diverter and supply power directly to the engines.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: O'Neill allows the knowledge of the Ancients to be downloaded into his mind again, even though the first time almost killed him. While he slowly deteriorates, he and SG-1 must race against time to uncover the secret of the Lost City of the Ancients.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When Anubis attacks Earth, General Hammond launches an offensive. Meanwhile, the search for the lost city continues and Jack's health deteriorates.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Carter and Teal'c are in search of the Asgard, trying to save Colonel O'Neill, but they're about to make a horrifying discovery: the Asgard's most deadly enemy has returned with a vengeance. Meanwhile, the System Lords seek an alliance with Earth against a common enemy.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While the Goa'uld threaten to attack Earth, SG-1 and the Asgard make a last, desperate stand against the Replicators, who have caught Major Carter.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When Jackson contracts a mysterious illness, O'Neill is convinced that a contagion has infected the base and orders a lockdown. But when Jackson reveals that he was actually possessed by Anubis, O'Neill must discover the identity of the new host!

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: General O'Neill tries to settle into his new job, but faces never-ending crises - including the capture of SG-1 by the Goa'uld.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Daniel is stranded on another planet after the team's arrival on an alien world sparks a\nviolent civil war.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Teal'c is trapped in a virtual reality simulation in which he must defend the base from a Goa'uld super-soldier incursion. To help him, O'Neill joins the 'game'.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Teal'c, having finally been cleared to live off-base, settles into his new neighborhood.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A businessman threatens to expose the secrets of alien life to the world, forcing Stargate Command to bring him into the loop.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Teal'c and Bra'tac try to convince the warrior-woman rebel leader Ishta to postpone her attack on the Goa'uld.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The members of the SG-1 are shocked to discover that the Stargate has been stolen from the command center by a mysterious beam, and it is soon discovered that The Trust is plotting to poison their enemies with the use of an advanced ship.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A duplicate of Colonel Carter seeks help from Stargate Command in defeating the Replicator Fifth.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: General Hammond and Daniel go on an expedition on the Prometheus to Atlantis. They encounter an abandoned Goa'uld Al'kesh and decide to salvage it. A Kull warrior rings aboard the ship and rings everyone else onto the Al'kesh leaving only Daniel onboard the Prometheus. The Kull warrior turns out to be a woman named Vala who wants to use Prometheus to evacuate her people from a Goa'uld occupied world. But is she telling the truth?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 arrives at Harry Maybourne's planet to find that he has been appointed king of a primitive people.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Relations are strained between the US government and Russia, Colonel Chekov pays a visit to General O'Neill with bad news, and security has been compromised.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Jack is shocked when a person he can't remember having ever met invades his home and makes outrageous claims about having his life ruined by his target, in addition to the alarming revelation that he knows all of the Stargate secrets.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Teal'c and Bra'tac believe the time is right to lead their people in an uprising against the Goa'uld. Their plan suffers a setback when an army of Replicators begins to systematically take control of Goa'uld ships and Jackson is taken prisoner.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The Jaffa Resistance assembles an army to retake a holy city. Plus, Baal seeks help from Earth when he is faced with a threat common to both parties.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: After apparently dying, Daniel is surprised to find himself trapped inside the confines of a mysterious diner that is filled with fellow Ascendants; Anubis takes advantage of an opportunity to scheme on complete conquests of the galaxy.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 and O'Neill utilise the time-puddle jumper to go to Ancient Egypt to recover a ZPM. When they return they discover that the future has been altered and SG-1 never existed. Meanwhile, archaeologists find the video camera Daniel took with them to Ancient Egypt with instructions to find the Stargate, track down Teal'c, and return to the past in order to correct the future.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1

programme.title: MythBusters
programme.desc: In this episode, Adam and Jamie unleash a deadly myth from a supermax prison, which sees them try to make a deadly weapon out of nothing more dangerous than newspaper and underwear. programme.title: MythBusters

programme.title: MythBusters
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test a myth that helium-filled footballs fly farther and hang longer than regulation balls, while Grant, Tory and Kari investigate if teeth are strong enough to withstand the force of a bullet.

programme.title: MythBusters

programme.title: MythBusters
programme.desc: In Helium Raft, get set for the biggest Mythbusters build ever. And yet it all starts so simply. The myth states that if you can fly if you fill a normal raft with helium, because helium is lighter than air.

programme.title: MythBusters
programme.desc: It's a constant source of frustration that not all of the testing footage can be included in the final show that goes to air. In this special episode, the outtakes are in, with never before seen footage and experiments from the MythBusters vault.

programme.title: MythBusters
programme.desc: A Mythbusters episode without controversy is about as rare as a duck in a tree. But in this episode, there's more controversy than a year's worth of Jerry Springer, as the team returns to some of the most controversial myths - the myths that generated a truck load of angry fan mail - and puts them back under the microscope.

programme.title: MythBusters
programme.desc: In Exploding Paint Adam and Jamie do a little painting and detonating when they attempt to blow wide open a home improvement myth. The story, from the TV archives, shows a lazy British comedian using dynamite to decorate.

programme.title: MythBusters

programme.title: MythBusters

programme.title: MythBusters
programme.desc: Are there whirlpools powerful enough to swallow entire ships? And, Tory, Kari and Grant attempt to bust the myth that a snowplough travelling on a highway blew an oncoming car off the road.

programme.title: MythBusters

programme.title: MythBusters

programme.title: MythBusters

programme.title: MythBusters
programme.desc: Myths tested: Can a hurricane blow a piece of straw through a tree? According to Primary Perception, do all living things share an interconnected consciousness?

programme.title: MythBusters
programme.desc: Myths tested: Can a machine designed by Nikola Tesla actually create a miniature earthquake or collapse a structure? Can a lava lamp explode if heated on the stove?

programme.title: MythBusters
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie explore the theory that if a high-tension cable snaps it can slice a person in two. Then, Grant, Tory and Kari investigate the myth that ancient pottery contains sounds from the past that can be heard today.

programme.title: MythBusters
programme.desc: In Concrete Glider, Adam and Jamie test the old engineering challenge that ‘like a lead balloon you can’t make a concrete glider fly’. And there’s nothing like a challenge to focus the Mythbusters massive minds!

programme.title: MythBusters
programme.desc: Put simply, this episode puts all our MythBusters ‘U.E.P.’- under extreme pressure. Adam and Jamie have unfinished business from their ‘Shark Week’ special, where they shot and then exploded a SCUBA tank.

programme.title: MythBusters

programme.title: MythBusters
programme.desc: Myths tested: Is it possible to survive a 22,000-foot fall using the blast from a 1000-pound bomb to break the fall? Is electricity saved by switching off the lights when leaving a room?

programme.title: MythBusters

programme.title: MythBusters

programme.title: MythBusters

The terminal, a 14-story combination office tower/train station, opened in 1929 and closed 50 years later. After falling through the hands of various owners, the Central Terminal Restoration Corp. acquired it in 1997. In the years since the Terminal's abandonment, it has become a potent source of paranormal stories.
